d: A deadly helicopter collision near Mount Everest in Nepal has killed a 47-year-old Indian tourist and left another passenger injured. Two helicopters operated by Fishtail Air and Air Dynasty collided while attempting to land at Pheriche in Nepal's Solukhumbu district, near Everest Base Camp. The accident occurred at around 8:11 am local time on Tuesday, after both helicopters took off from Lukla Airport, the gateway to Mount Everest.
